name: Asset - Inventory Check

parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.asset_code, a.name, a.asset_type, a.status, a.assigned_to, a.location, a.tenant_id FROM ast_assets a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.tenant_id, a.asset_type;

INSERT INTO ast_inventory_checks (tenant_id, total_assets, check_date) SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*), NOW() FROM ast_assets WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, check_date::date) DO UPDATE SET total_assets = EXCLUDED.total_assets;
SELECT c.channel_id, COUNT(a.id) as total FROM ast_it_managers c JOIN ast_assets a ON a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.channel_id;
